body:
## Incident
[Staging run #2200](https://github.com/PlebeianApp/market/actions/runs/37336956656) failed in `Activate release`:
`Couldn't find patch file: 'patches/rxjs@7.8.2.patch'`

The partial package contained `package.json` with `patchedDependencies` but omitted `patches/`. Staging rollback successfully restored the previous release. The same latent defect existed in staging, AuctionsDev, and production release packaging.

## Fix
- Add `cp -r patches deploy-package/` to the three affected workflows.
- Port/adapt only the packaging regression guard from #1371. It discovers partial-package workflows, checks non-vacuous coverage, and requires `package.json`, `bun.lock`, and `patches/`.
- Preserve the already-landed preview packaging behavior.

This ports only the already-reviewed packaging/guard portion of #1371. It does **not** import unrelated #1363/#1371 changes, including NIP-46, preview seeding, gateway, application, dependency, or Bun-version changes.

## Verification
- Focused Bun guard: 32 passed, 0 failed, 97 assertions.
- Regression control against original workflows: 31 passed, 1 targeted failure naming exactly the three missing patch directories.
- Installed Prettier 3.8.3 and `git diff --check`: passed.
- Independent read-only A2: FREEZE.
- Exact scope: four files, +42/-1; all three workflow diffs are one added copy line. NIP-46 values and dependency/patch inputs unchanged.
- The automatic preview deployment is green. Preview already had its own patch-packaging repair, so preview success does not validate the staging fix.
- No runtime staging deployment has yet validated this fix; staging acceptance remains post-merge.

## Current provenance and status
- Current base: `614ff3a0def0ebc260747a3c0b76f7e88c383c3b`
- Current PR head / merge-forward refresh: `bbe43a56598c8d0dd6adb1bfba75a3f55d6f1b9d`
- Original reviewed hotfix: `e989381b1388ceeabbe0d5abfc64be4926a71c18`

The hotfix was merge-forward refreshed onto current master. The reviewed hotfix diff remained unchanged; the resulting diff against current master is exactly four files, +42/-1.

At this head, all required checks are green: footprint, security-scan, prettier, unit-integration, and e2e-grep. Deploy preview is also green; e2e-full and Tear down preview are expected skips. Human maintainer approval remains required.

## Post-merge staging acceptance
Incident closure requires an automatic Deploy to Staging from the eventual merged master commit where:
1. `bun install --production` succeeds;
2. `Couldn't find patch file: 'patches/rxjs@7.8.2.patch'` does not recur;
3. PM2 release activation succeeds;
4. Caddy update succeeds;
5. the `/api/config` health check succeeds.

This acceptance remains pending and is not established by preview CI.
title: fix(deploy): include dependency patches in release packages
